# BahasaCerdas — Platform Edukasi Bahasa Indonesia

## About
BahasaCerdas is an Indonesian language education platform combining AI tools, interactive quizzes, teacher marketplace, and MGMP community. Built by teachers, for teachers.

Website: https://www.bahasacerdas.com
Contact: halo@bahasacerdas.com

## Key Pages
- Homepage: https://www.bahasacerdas.com
- Features: https://www.bahasacerdas.com/fitur
- About: https://www.bahasacerdas.com/tentang
- FAQ: https://www.bahasacerdas.com/faq
- Privacy Policy: https://www.bahasacerdas.com/kebijakan-privasi
- Terms: https://www.bahasacerdas.com/syarat-ketentuan

## Core Features
- AI Generator RPP — Create Kurikulum Merdeka lesson plans in 30 seconds
- HOTS Question Generator — Generate higher-order thinking skills questions
- EYD Corrector — Automatic spelling and grammar checking
- Multiplayer Quiz — Interactive educational games for students
- Teacher Marketplace — Buy and sell teaching materials (80% seller commission)
- MGMP Community — Discussion forums, webinars, and teacher collaboration
- Question Bank — Thousands of ready-to-use assessment questions

## Pricing
- Free tier: Basic features, community access
- Guru Pro: Full AI access, starting from Rp 49.000/month, 30-day trial

## Target Audience
- Indonesian language teachers (SMP, SMA, SMK, MA)
- Students learning Indonesian language

## Technical
- Platform: Web-based (Next.js)
- Auth: Supabase
- Payment: Midtrans
- SSL: 256-bit encryption
